title: Medical AI Data Generation Platform (gen-g)
summary: A full-stack web application for generating synthetic medical data (patient demographics, medications, labs, vitals), synthetic X-ray/MRI images via GANs, and medical literature summarization. Its Flask backend loads 25+ pre-trained synthesizers and uses SDV's SingleTableMetadata plus run_diagnostic/evaluate_quality to validate the quality of the generated synthetic tabular data.
